infer_piecewise_pattern_from_path <- function(file_path) {
  b <- basename(file_path)
  if (grepl("crossing", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("crossing")
  if (grepl("diverging", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("diverging")
  if (grepl("diminishing", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("diminishing")
  if (grepl("_PH_", b, ignore.case = TRUE) || grepl("PH", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("PH")
  if (grepl("reversed", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("reversed")
  if (grepl("H0", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("H0")
  "unspecified"
}

standardize_piecewise_weibull_export <- function(final_sav, file_path) {
  if (is.null(final_sav) || nrow(final_sav) == 0) return(final_sav)
  pat <- infer_piecewise_pattern_from_path(file_path)
  control_pars <- paste0(
    "Pre Weibull(shape=", final_sav$c_shape_pre, ", scale=", final_sav$c_scale_pre,
    "); Post Weibull(shape=", final_sav$c_shape_post, ", scale=", final_sav$c_scale_post, ")"
  )
  treatment_pars <- paste0(
    "Pre Weibull(shape=", final_sav$t_shape_pre, ", scale=", final_sav$t_scale_pre,
    "); Post Weibull(shape=", final_sav$t_shape_post, ", scale=", final_sav$t_scale_post, ")"
  )
  before_eff <- paste0(
    "Control Weibull(shape=", final_sav$c_shape_pre, ", scale=", final_sav$c_scale_pre,
    ") vs Treatment Weibull(shape=", final_sav$t_shape_pre, ", scale=", final_sav$t_scale_pre, ")"
  )
  after_eff <- paste0(
    "Control Weibull(shape=", final_sav$c_shape_post, ", scale=", final_sav$c_scale_post,
    ") vs Treatment Weibull(shape=", final_sav$t_shape_post, ", scale=", final_sav$t_scale_post, ")"
  )
  front <- data.frame(
    Type = final_sav$type,
    rate1 = final_sav$rate1,
    rate2 = final_sav$rate2,
    family = "PiecewiseWeibull",
    scenario = pat,
    control = control_pars,
    treatment = treatment_pars,
    before_effect = before_eff,
    after_effect = after_eff,
    additional = "Fixed follow-up duration = 5 years",
    target = NA_real_,
    change1 = final_sav$change1,
    change2 = final_sav$change2,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  results <- final_sav[, -(1:13), drop = FALSE]
  desc <- data.frame(
    before = paste0("Before t=1: ", before_eff),
    after  = paste0("After t=1: ", after_eff),
    overall = paste0("Piecewise Weibull ", pat, " pattern; change point=1; fixed follow-up=5"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out <- cbind(front, results, desc)
  colnames(out) <- c(common_export_front_headers, result_headers[-(1:13)], common_distribution_description_headers)
  out <- out[, c(setdiff(names(out), c("rec", "Average Number of Knots")),
                 "rec", "Average Number of Knots"), drop = FALSE]
  out
}

standardize_piecewise_lognormal_export <- function(final_sav, file_path) {
  if (is.null(final_sav) || nrow(final_sav) == 0) return(final_sav)
  pat <- infer_piecewise_pattern_from_path(file_path)
  control_pars <- paste0(
    "Pre LogNormal(meanlog=", final_sav$c_shape_pre, ", sdlog=", final_sav$c_scale_pre,
    "); Post LogNormal(meanlog=", final_sav$c_shape_post, ", sdlog=", final_sav$c_scale_post, ")"
  )
  treatment_pars <- paste0(
    "Piecewise HR multipliers: pre=", final_sav$t_shape_pre,
    "; post=", final_sav$t_shape_post,
    "; applied to the same piecewise log-normal baseline"
  )
  before_eff <- paste0("Treatment HR multiplier before change=", final_sav$t_shape_pre)
  after_eff <- paste0("Treatment HR multiplier after change=", final_sav$t_shape_post)
  front <- data.frame(
    Type = final_sav$type,
    rate1 = final_sav$rate1,
    rate2 = final_sav$rate2,
    family = paste0("PiecewiseLogNormal_", pat),
    scenario = final_sav$type,
    control = control_pars,
    treatment = treatment_pars,
    before_effect = before_eff,
    after_effect = after_eff,
    additional = "Fixed follow-up duration = 5 years",
    target = NA_real_,
    change1 = final_sav$change1,
    change2 = final_sav$change2,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  results <- final_sav[, -(1:13), drop = FALSE]
  desc <- data.frame(
    before = paste0("Before t=1: control log-normal baseline; ", before_eff),
    after = paste0("After t=1: control log-normal baseline; ", after_eff),
    overall = paste0("Piecewise log-normal ", pat, " pattern; exact segment-specific HRs; change point=1; fixed follow-up=5"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out <- cbind(front, results, desc)
  colnames(out) <- c(common_export_front_headers, result_headers[-(1:13)], common_distribution_description_headers)
  out <- out[, c(setdiff(names(out), c("rec", "Average Number of Knots")),
                 "rec", "Average Number of Knots"), drop = FALSE]
  out
}


save_result_file <- function(final_sav, file_path, headers, sheet_name = "Sheet 1") {

  if (nrow(final_sav) > 0) {
    final_sav <- final_sav[order(
      final_sav$type,
      final_sav$rate1, final_sav$rate2,
      final_sav$c_shape_pre,  final_sav$c_shape_post,
      final_sav$c_scale_pre,  final_sav$c_scale_post,
      final_sav$t_shape_pre,  final_sav$t_shape_post,
      final_sav$t_scale_pre,  final_sav$t_scale_post
    ), ]

    final_sav <- standardize_piecewise_weibull_export(final_sav, file_path)
  }

  wb <- if (file.exists(file_path)) loadWorkbook(file_path) else createWorkbook()

  if (!(sheet_name %in% names(wb))) {
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  }

  if (sheet_name %in% names(wb)) {
    removeWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  }

  if (nrow(final_sav) > 0) {
    writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = final_sav)
  }

  saveWorkbook(wb, file = file_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("Excel file saved to:", file_path, "\n")
}

directory_path <- "C:/Users/admin/Downloads/fixed_followup_H0/Spline_fixed_followup"

# Piecewise Weibull H0 scenarios
make_weibull_h0_scenarios <- function(hazard_pattern = c("increasing", "decreasing", "stable"),
                                       null_mode = c("equal", "worse")) {
  hazard_pattern <- match.arg(hazard_pattern)
  null_mode <- match.arg(null_mode)
  rec_values <- c(3.5, 4.5, 5.5)

  if (hazard_pattern == "stable") {
    base <- data.frame(
      scale = c(5.2, 5.8, 6.4, 7.0, 7.6, 8.2),
      change_scale = 1
    )
  } else {
    base <- expand.grid(
      scale = c(5.5, 7.0, 8.5),
      change_scale = if (hazard_pattern == "increasing") c(0.90, 0.80) else c(1.10, 1.20),
      KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE
    )
  }

  tab <- base[rep(seq_len(nrow(base)), each = length(rec_values)), , drop = FALSE]
  tab$rec <- rep(rec_values, times = nrow(base))
  tab$scenario_id <- seq_len(nrow(tab))

  shape <- switch(hazard_pattern, increasing = 1.35, decreasing = 0.75, stable = 1.00)
  tab$c_shape_pre <- shape
  tab$c_shape_post <- shape
  tab$c_scale_pre <- tab$scale
  tab$c_scale_post <- tab$scale * tab$change_scale
  tab$t_shape_pre <- tab$c_shape_pre
  tab$t_shape_post <- tab$c_shape_post
  worse_factor <- if (null_mode == "worse") 0.85 else 1.00
  tab$t_scale_pre <- tab$c_scale_pre * worse_factor
  tab$t_scale_post <- tab$c_scale_post * worse_factor
  tab
}

run_weibull_h0_family <- function(extrap_dist, hazard_pattern, null_mode, family_seed,
                                  num_simulations = 1000, checkpoint_file = NULL) {
  tab <- make_weibull_h0_scenarios(hazard_pattern, null_mode)
  final_sav <- data.frame()
  if (!is.null(checkpoint_file)) save_result_file(final_sav, checkpoint_file, result_headers)

  for (j in seq_len(nrow(tab))) {
    set.seed(family_seed + j - 1L)
    r <- tab[j, , drop = FALSE]
    sav1 <- simu(
      type = "Unblinded", alpha = 0.05, beta = 0.1, rate1 = 0.6, rate2 = 0.4,
      c_shape_pre = r$c_shape_pre[[1]], c_shape_post = r$c_shape_post[[1]],
      c_scale_pre = r$c_scale_pre[[1]], c_scale_post = r$c_scale_post[[1]],
      t_shape_pre = r$t_shape_pre[[1]], t_shape_post = r$t_shape_post[[1]],
      t_scale_pre = r$t_scale_pre[[1]], t_scale_post = r$t_scale_post[[1]],
      change1 = 1, change2 = 1, rec = r$rec[[1]], CL = 0.2, CU = 0.9,
      num_simulations = num_simulations, extrap_dist = extrap_dist
    )
    if (!is.null(sav1) && nrow(sav1) > 0) {
      sav1$type <- paste0("PiecewiseWeibull_H0_",
                         if (null_mode == "equal") "TreatmentEqualControl_" else "TreatmentWorseThanControl_",
                         hazard_pattern, "_", sprintf("%02d", j))
      final_sav <- rbind(final_sav, sav1)
      if (!is.null(checkpoint_file)) save_result_file(final_sav, checkpoint_file, result_headers)
    }
  }
  final_sav
}

# Piecewise log-normal H0 scenarios
piecewise_lognormal_change <- 1

S_lognormal_segment <- function(t, meanlog, sdlog) {
  t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
  out <- rep(1, length(t))
  pos <- t > 0
  if (any(pos)) out[pos] <- plnorm(t[pos], meanlog = meanlog, sdlog = sdlog, lower.tail = FALSE)
  pmin(pmax(out, 0), 1)
}

H_lognormal_segment <- function(t, meanlog, sdlog) {
  -log(pmax(S_lognormal_segment(t, meanlog, sdlog), 1e-15))
}

qH_lognormal_segment <- function(z, meanlog, sdlog) {
  p <- 1 - exp(-pmax(as.numeric(z), 0))
  qlnorm(pmin(pmax(p, 1e-12), 1 - 1e-12), meanlog = meanlog, sdlog = sdlog)
}

rlognormal_piecewise_hr <- function(n, meanlog_pre, sdlog_pre, meanlog_post, sdlog_post,
                                    hr_pre = 1, hr_post = 1, c = piecewise_lognormal_change) {
  z <- rexp(n)
  Hc_pre <- H_lognormal_segment(c, meanlog_pre, sdlog_pre)
  Hc_post <- H_lognormal_segment(c, meanlog_post, sdlog_post)
  HcT <- hr_pre * Hc_pre
  out <- numeric(n)
  before <- z <= HcT
  if (any(before)) {
    out[before] <- qH_lognormal_segment(z[before] / hr_pre, meanlog_pre, sdlog_pre)
  }
  if (any(!before)) {
    target_H_post <- Hc_post + (z[!before] - HcT) / hr_post
    out[!before] <- qH_lognormal_segment(target_H_post, meanlog_post, sdlog_post)
  }
  out
}

S_lognormal_piecewise_hr <- function(t, meanlog_pre, sdlog_pre, meanlog_post, sdlog_post,
                                     hr_pre = 1, hr_post = 1, c = piecewise_lognormal_change) {
  t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
  H <- numeric(length(t))
  pre <- t <= c
  Hc_pre <- H_lognormal_segment(c, meanlog_pre, sdlog_pre)
  Hc_post <- H_lognormal_segment(c, meanlog_post, sdlog_post)
  if (any(pre)) {
    H[pre] <- hr_pre * H_lognormal_segment(t[pre], meanlog_pre, sdlog_pre)
  }
  if (any(!pre)) {
    Hpost_inc <- H_lognormal_segment(t[!pre], meanlog_post, sdlog_post) - Hc_post
    H[!pre] <- hr_pre * Hc_pre + hr_post * Hpost_inc
  }
  out <- exp(-H)
  out[t == 0] <- 1
  pmin(pmax(out, 0), 1)
}

make_lognormal_h0_scenarios <- function(hazard_pattern = c("increasing", "decreasing", "stable"),
                                        null_mode = c("equal", "worse")) {
  hazard_pattern <- match.arg(hazard_pattern)
  null_mode <- match.arg(null_mode)
  rec_values <- c(3.5, 4.5, 5.5)
  base <- expand.grid(
    median = c(2.2, 2.8, 3.4),
    sdlog = c(0.68, 0.88),
    KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE
  )
  tab <- base[rep(seq_len(nrow(base)), each = length(rec_values)), , drop = FALSE]
  tab$rec <- rep(rec_values, times = nrow(base))
  tab$scenario_id <- seq_len(nrow(tab))
  tab$c_meanlog_pre <- log(tab$median)
  tab$c_sdlog_pre <- tab$sdlog
  tab$c_meanlog_post <- log(tab$median)
  tab$c_sdlog_post <- tab$sdlog
  mult <- switch(hazard_pattern, increasing = c(0.75, 1.25), decreasing = c(1.25, 0.75), stable = c(1, 1))
  tab$c_hr_pre <- mult[1]
  tab$c_hr_post <- mult[2]
  worse_factor <- if (null_mode == "worse") 1.25 else 1.00
  tab$t_hr_pre <- tab$c_hr_pre * worse_factor
  tab$t_hr_post <- tab$c_hr_post * worse_factor
  tab
}

run_lognormal_h0_family <- function(extrap_dist, hazard_pattern, null_mode, family_seed,
                                    num_simulations = 1000, checkpoint_file = NULL) {
  tab <- make_lognormal_h0_scenarios(hazard_pattern, null_mode)
  final_sav <- data.frame()
  if (!is.null(checkpoint_file)) save_result_file(final_sav, checkpoint_file, result_headers)

  for (j in seq_len(nrow(tab))) {
    set.seed(family_seed + j - 1L)
    r <- tab[j, , drop = FALSE]
    cpt <- piecewise_lognormal_change
    gen_c <- function(n) rlognormal_piecewise_hr(n, r$c_meanlog_pre[[1]], r$c_sdlog_pre[[1]], r$c_meanlog_post[[1]], r$c_sdlog_post[[1]], r$c_hr_pre[[1]], r$c_hr_post[[1]], cpt)
    gen_t <- function(n) rlognormal_piecewise_hr(n, r$c_meanlog_pre[[1]], r$c_sdlog_pre[[1]], r$c_meanlog_post[[1]], r$c_sdlog_post[[1]], r$t_hr_pre[[1]], r$t_hr_post[[1]], cpt)
    S_c <- function(t) S_lognormal_piecewise_hr(t, r$c_meanlog_pre[[1]], r$c_sdlog_pre[[1]], r$c_meanlog_post[[1]], r$c_sdlog_post[[1]], r$c_hr_pre[[1]], r$c_hr_post[[1]], cpt)
    S_t <- function(t) S_lognormal_piecewise_hr(t, r$c_meanlog_pre[[1]], r$c_sdlog_pre[[1]], r$c_meanlog_post[[1]], r$c_sdlog_post[[1]], r$t_hr_pre[[1]], r$t_hr_post[[1]], cpt)

    sav1 <- simu(
      type = "Unblinded", alpha = 0.05, beta = 0.1, rate1 = 0.6, rate2 = 0.4,
      c_shape_pre = NA_real_, c_shape_post = NA_real_, c_scale_pre = NA_real_, c_scale_post = NA_real_,
      t_shape_pre = NA_real_, t_shape_post = NA_real_, t_scale_pre = NA_real_, t_scale_post = NA_real_,
      change1 = cpt, change2 = cpt, rec = r$rec[[1]], CL = 0.2, CU = 0.9,
      num_simulations = num_simulations, extrap_dist = extrap_dist,
      event_generator_control = gen_c, event_generator_treatment = gen_t,
      S_control_override = S_c, S_treatment_override = S_t
    )
    if (!is.null(sav1) && nrow(sav1) > 0) {
      sav1$type <- paste0("PiecewiseLogNormal_H0_",
                         if (null_mode == "equal") "TreatmentEqualControl_" else "TreatmentWorseThanControl_",
                         hazard_pattern, "_", sprintf("%02d", j))
      sav1$c_shape_pre <- r$c_meanlog_pre[[1]]
      sav1$c_shape_post <- r$c_meanlog_post[[1]]
      sav1$c_scale_pre <- r$c_sdlog_pre[[1]]
      sav1$c_scale_post <- r$c_sdlog_post[[1]]
      sav1$t_shape_pre <- r$t_hr_pre[[1]] / r$c_hr_pre[[1]]
      sav1$t_shape_post <- r$t_hr_post[[1]] / r$c_hr_post[[1]]
      sav1$t_scale_pre <- NA_real_
      sav1$t_scale_post <- NA_real_
      final_sav <- rbind(final_sav, sav1)
      if (!is.null(checkpoint_file)) save_result_file(final_sav, checkpoint_file, result_headers)
    }
  }
  final_sav
}

h0_output_definitions <- expand.grid(
  distribution = c("PiecewiseWeibull", "PiecewiseLogNormal"),
  hazard_pattern = c("increasing", "decreasing", "stable"),
  null_mode = c("equal", "worse"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
h0_output_definitions$seed <- 21000000L + seq_len(nrow(h0_output_definitions)) * 10000L

run_all_h0_outputs <- function() {
  jobs <- expand.grid(
    method_key = names(extrapolation_methods),
    output_index = seq_len(nrow(h0_output_definitions)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  run_one_job <- function(k) {
    method_key <- jobs$method_key[[k]]
    j <- jobs$output_index[[k]]
    method_label <- unname(extrapolation_methods[method_key])
    d <- h0_output_definitions[j, , drop = FALSE]
    null_label <- if (d$null_mode[[1]] == "equal") "TreatmentEqualControl" else "TreatmentWorseThanControl"
    file_stub <- paste("H0_Unblinded", null_label, d$distribution[[1]], d$hazard_pattern[[1]], sep = "_")
    file_path <- file.path(directory_path, paste0(file_stub, "_", method_label, ".xlsx"))

    if (d$distribution[[1]] == "PiecewiseWeibull") {
      ans <- run_weibull_h0_family(
        method_key, d$hazard_pattern[[1]], d$null_mode[[1]], d$seed[[1]],
        num_simulations_per_scenario, file_path
      )
    } else {
      ans <- run_lognormal_h0_family(
        method_key, d$hazard_pattern[[1]], d$null_mode[[1]], d$seed[[1]],
        num_simulations_per_scenario, file_path
      )
    }

    save_result_file(ans, file_path, result_headers)
    file_path
  }

  n_cores <- max(1L, parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE) - 1L)
  n_workers <- min(n_cores, nrow(jobs))

  if (n_workers <= 1L) {
    generated_files <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(jobs)), run_one_job)
  } else if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
    cl <- parallel::makeCluster(n_workers)
    on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl), add = TRUE)

    parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, {
      suppressPackageStartupMessages({
        library(openxlsx)
        library(survival)
        library(stats)
        library(dplyr)
        library(gsDesign)
        library(flexsurv)
      })
      NULL
    })

    export_names <- setdiff(ls(envir = .GlobalEnv, all.names = TRUE), ".Random.seed")
    parallel::clusterExport(cl, export_names, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    parallel::clusterExport(cl, c("jobs", "run_one_job"), envir = environment())

    generated_files <- parallel::parLapply(
      cl, seq_len(nrow(jobs)),
      function(k) run_one_job(k)
    )
  } else {
    generated_files <- parallel::mclapply(
      seq_len(nrow(jobs)),
      run_one_job,
      mc.cores = n_workers,
      mc.preschedule = TRUE,
      mc.set.seed = FALSE
    )
  }

  invisible(unlist(generated_files, use.names = FALSE))
}
run_all_h0_outputs()
